hypothesis: For this one occluded moving-hair advertisement, actual dynamic video erasure followed by source-region compositing removed the frozen-head failure. A low-budget retimed input can yield a reviewable pilot, but exact frame mapping and new visual review are essential; it is not a generally validated cost-saving recipe.
